highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews the Skia m156 renderer and expands support for GTK4, Tizen 10, and .NET 11.
highlights_body: It adds native GTK4 GPU rendering, updates platform and WebAssembly build assets, and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments.

breaking.title: Tizen 8 and 9 are no longer supported
breaking.body: Tizen native assets and package targets now require Tizen 10. Update Tizen applications and device-test manifests to target Tizen 10 before upgrading.

breaking.title: High-density GTK4 drawing uses physical pixels by default
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now creates physical-pixel backing surfaces on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true when an existing application requires logical paint coordinates.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to the m156 engine line while preserving the existing managed API surface.
Aligns the bundled m155 native sources more closely with upstream while retaining compatibility required by supported toolchains.

bullets.lead: GTK4 gains a GPU-backed drawing control
bullets.detail: SKGLArea provides a GTK-owned OpenGL Skia canvas with paint events, render-loop control, and explicit physical or logical pixel behavior.

bullets.lead: Linux NoDependencies finds installed system fonts
bullets.detail: The no-fontconfig Linux native package again discovers fonts from the configured system font directory, restoring family-based font matching.

bullets.lead: .NET 11 WebAssembly assets are aligned with the preview toolchain
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp packages select matching WebAssembly archives for .NET 11 and later, avoiding a stale toolchain selection.

bullets.lead: Tizen 10 with GCC 14.2 is the supported native baseline
bullets.detail: Tizen x64 and arm64 native assets now target Tizen 10 and its GCC 14.2 toolchain.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 opens the 4.156 line with the Skia m156 engine, GTK4 GPU rendering, and updated .NET 11 WebAssembly and Tizen support.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 accompanies the m156 line with the aligned WebAssembly assets, Tizen baseline, and Linux font-discovery support.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m156 renderer and expanded GTK4, Tizen, and .NET 11 support.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: It adds a GPU-backed GTK4 control, updates native platform baselines, and restores Linux NoDependencies system-font discovery.
